face.name: 拉夏
face.text: 战吼：拼装一个任意职业的随从，将其变形成为一项被动英雄技能。
face.flavorText: 如果没有太阳，生命必将枯萎。然而太阳并不在乎生命。它散发着光芒，比魔法还要闪亮，甚至可以融化我们脚下的岩石。因此，拉夏肩上的责任极为重大。

face.name: Rajh
face.text: Battlecry: Assemble a minion from any class. Transform it into a Passive Hero Power.
face.flavorText: Without the sun, life withers. But the sun cares not for life. It shines brighter than magic. It can melt the very stones beneath our feet. So it was Rajh who was left the greatest responsibility.

policy.inventory: All fourteen original published identities, unit local weights. Reported fifteenth identity remains unknown; no replacement is invented. Earlier 18+25 demo widget is preserved as conflicting reference, not merged into this list.
policy.roles: Original thirteen minions may be primary or secondary; TLC_833 is a reviewed secondary weapon-text projection under the existing assembly role rule, not a new physical minion.
policy.keywords: Passive power carries the assembled trigger and subject. Explicit Elusive/Divine Shield minion-only keywords are omitted on the healthless power; they do not grant keywords to the hero. This is a local conversion policy.
policy.execution: Only the real approved immutable assembled-power carrier can use existing living-source conditions and captured reaction callbacks. Original minion/weapon definitions, subjects and effect bodies remain intact.
policy.source: The previous three approved passive fragments stay compatible for their existing fixtures; none is added to the fourteen-member candidate inventory.

uncertainties: The community report explicitly lacks one of fifteen members; official membership/roles, weights and current CN patch identity remain unconfirmed.
Primary-minion/secondary-weapon role and original secondary cost window are retained local policies pending evidence, rather than changing the original simulator query.
Ignoring intrinsic minion keywords on the passive power, captured/replaced power trigger timing and existing native spell entry distinctions are not current CN calibrated.
The earlier 43-ID demo widget and the explicit fourteen-name report disagree; identities are retained separately.
Other disputed Assemble combinations remain restricted by the existing explicit policy.
